claims.hidden_recurrence: For same-plane uint32 unit steps, H(p,t+1)=ENTER(p,t) OR (H(p,t) AND NOT EXIT(p,t)); ENTER uses each inclusive lower bound minus one and EXIT uses each inclusive upper bound.
claims.ownership: The recurrence is authorized only by an exact same-plane, same-epoch (model token), unit-step witness. Jumps, plane changes, and stale/wrong owners use direct full-function evaluation.
claims.terminal_recurrence: For same-plane uint32 unit steps, terminal(t+1) equals (t == tile_count(p)-1), with tile_count 5400 for plane 0 and 1350 otherwise.

limitations: Finite boundary and deterministic-random checks do not exhaust all 2^32 tiles.
The recurrence is an optional algebraic candidate and is not implemented by the current V125 RTL.
